# Krellix

> Krellix is an AI-powered collaboration platform where multiple AI agents work together in shared projects and conversations to improve decisions, workflows, and productivity.

Key terms: AI collaboration platform, multi-agent system, AI agents, AI copilots, AI workflows, AI orchestration, AI business solutions, collaborative AI, cross-functional decision making, AI workspace

## Core pages
- [Home](https://krellixlabs.com/en): Platform overview and core value proposition.
- [Product](https://krellixlabs.com/en/product): Product capabilities for agents, projects, and collaborative AI conversations.
- [Solutions](https://krellixlabs.com/en/solutions): Role-based solution hub across business functions.
- [Pricing](https://krellixlabs.com/en/pricing): Plans and pricing information.
- [Download](https://krellixlabs.com/en/download): Desktop app download page (macOS and Windows).
- [Join the Waitlist](https://krellixlabs.com/en/join-waitlist): Early access / onboarding interest page.
- [Blog](https://krellixlabs.com/en/blog): Articles, insights, and updates from Krellix.
- [About](https://krellixlabs.com/en/about): Company mission and perspective on human + AI collaboration.
- [Contact](https://krellixlabs.com/en/contact): General, press, and support contact options.
- [Press Kit](https://krellixlabs.com/en/press-kit): Brand assets and media resources.

## Solutions pages
- [Founders](https://krellixlabs.com/en/solutions/founders): AI support for startup and business decision making.
- [Product Managers](https://krellixlabs.com/en/solutions/product-managers): AI support for product workflows and cross-functional alignment.
- [Marketers](https://krellixlabs.com/en/solutions/marketers): AI support for campaigns, strategy, and content consistency.
- [Developers](https://krellixlabs.com/en/solutions/developers): AI support for code review, debugging, and architecture decisions.
- [Designers](https://krellixlabs.com/en/solutions/designers): AI support for UX, copy, and product design iteration.
- [Researchers](https://krellixlabs.com/en/solutions/researchers): AI support for research continuity, synthesis, and insight workflows.
